choice: a head's latest review or fix carries the CI failure while it is queued or running, or while it is a finished review whose verdict is still due
why: SPEC T2 says a finished review carries the failure only while its verdict is still due; a verdict that already acted on another head must not hold back a ready at this head

choice: due until a trusted verdict naming the review's head and round, posted after the review's ready, is in handled_comments
why: job order cannot prove a verdict acted (r1 f-2): a poll snapshot can hide an already-posted verdict, and the newer job then let T2 split the fix

choice: a handled verdict counts whatever its outcome, except rejected-edited
why: approve-ci-red-fix, stale and over-cap verdicts never act again, so waiting on them would strand CI recovery; an edited verdict must be reposted (#18), and its corrected repost is the one that carries the CI failure (r2 f-2)

choice: the T2 fix key gains :after-<id> of the newest review or fix queued after the last fix at that head and generation
why: a second return to the same red head deduped onto the first finished fix and left nothing runnable (r1 f-1); a reposted ready with nothing in between still dedupes as before

decision: repeat key of the latest fix
choice: the key reads the newest keyed fix first and reuses its own key when no review or fix followed it
why: the old inner join skipped a newest keyed fix with nothing after it and let an older keyed fix pick that newest fix as its later job, so each repost after two returns got a fresh key and a new fix (r2 f-3)

choice: handled_comments stores a trusted verdict's head and round the first time a poll sees it handled, and the due check reads that record ordered by handled rowid after the review's ready
why: the due check re-parsed the verdict body from the poll snapshot, so a snapshot missing an already-handled APPROVE kept the review due, T2 handled the red ready as carried, and the verdict's return queued nothing (r3 f-1)

choice: the verdict head and round live in their own verdict_heads table keyed like handled_comments, not as two new handled_comments columns
why: the added columns broke every positional four-value INSERT INTO handled_comments in the tests (CI on 75e47b6: test_eval_metrics, test_hooks), and the comment_links side table already sets this pattern
